label: Horses and donkeys

names.text: The article's lead says the family is 'commonly known as the horse family' and covers horses, donkeys and other asses, and zebras. 'Horses and donkeys' is the item's given label.

sources.text: The lead gives Equidae as a family (Gray, 1821) in the order Perissodactyla. The item's given taxon is Equidae (family).

about.text: The horse family includes horses, donkeys and other asses, and zebras, with only one living genus, Equus. Donkey milk has been used since antiquity, and today a few donkey dairies milk small yields, since the foal needs most of the milk early on.

sources.text: The Equidae sentences are from the article as fetched with WebFetch. The donkey-milk sentences are from search-result text for the Donkey milk article and related pages, not from a page opened in full. Daily yields and milking limits were not checked against a fetched page.

gaps: No single world milk figure is given for the group; it is a family of several species, and its species count is not settled (the Equidae article lists seven living species in the classification section). Mare's milk was searched for but no sourced detail was found.
